title: Pull requests: Saved whitespace preferences and improved split view
author: Allison
description: Two improvements make it easier to review pull requests in the “Files changed” page: You can save your whitespace visibility preference across pull requests New and deleted files now use… The post Pull requests: Saved whitespace preferences and improved split view appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
summary: Your saved preference is personal and applies across pull requests. When whitespace is hidden, an active Hide whitespace filter appears beside All commits .
